Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: New Technical Institution offering Technical Course(s) / Programme(s) shall NOT be established without prior approval of the Council.
Activating_Conditions: Always for establishment of new technical institution
Potential_Verification_Method: AICTE Web Portal / National Single Window System

Requirement_Title: Mandatory National Single Window System Filing
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: online application on AICTE Web Portal through National Single Window System(NSWS) is mandatory. Application submitted offline shall NOT be accepted.
Potential_Verification_Method: NSWS Portal Transaction Reference

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: A Society, registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860...; or A Trust, registered under the Indian Trust Act, 1882...; or A Company established under Section 8 of the Companies Act, 2013.
Required_Supporting_Document: Trust Deed / Society Registration / Certificate of Incorporation
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: Registrar of Societies / Charity Commissioner / MCA
Potential_Verification_Method: MCA Portal / State Charity Commissioner Register

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: A Company having any foreign equity directly or indirectly as shareholding shall NOT be permitted to apply for setting up a Technical Institution (with exceptions provided by the Government).
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Current shareholding as of application date
Potential_Verification_Method: MCA21 Company Master Data Inspection

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: All the documents to be submitted along with on online applications should be DIGITALLY SIGNED (using Digital Signature Certificate-DSC)... Institutions shall NOT be Permitted to Submit Applications without DSC.
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Valid DSC at time of upload
Potential_Verification_Method: Cryptographic PDF /ByteRange validation against CCA Root CA

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: All Applicants shall submit an Affidavit 2 sworn before First Class Judicial Magistrate or Public Notary or an Oath Commissioner on Rs.100/- Non-Judicial stamp paper/ e-stamp paper (Digitally Signed).
Potential_Verification_Method: Notary / Judicial Magistrate Seal & Signature
Human_Review_Required: State e-Stamp verification portal / Notary Registry

Requirement_Title: Receipt of Application Submission to State & University
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: All the Applicants shall submit a copy of the application... to the State Government/UT and affiliating University/ Board immediately and get a receipt with the Official Seal
Required_Supporting_Document: Official Receipt with Seal from State DTE and University
Potential_Verification_Method: Manual inspection of receiving seal / State DTE confirmation

Requirement_Title: Lawful Land Possession and Clear Title
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: The Promoter Trust/ Society/ Company shall have the Land and built-up area as required and its Lawful possession with clear title in the name of the Promoter Trust/Society/Company on or before the date of submission of application.
Required_Supporting_Document: Registered Sale Deed / Gift Deed / Govt Lease Deed (min 30 yrs)
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Min 30 years duration (at least 5 yrs live lease at application)
Potential_Verification_Method: State Land Records Portal (Bhoomi / Mahabhulekh / IGR)

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Building Plan for the entire duration of the Programme(s)... shall be prepared by an Architect registered with Council of Architecture/ Licensed Surveyor and shall be approved by the Competent Authority
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: Registered Architect & Municipal / Town Planning Authority
Required_Authentication: Council of Architecture registration number & Municipal Seal
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Valid building approval prior to construction
Potential_Verification_Method: Council of Architecture membership lookup / Municipal approval record

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: The fund position of the Applicant shall be in the form of FDRs and/ or Bank accounts in the Nationalized Bank or Scheduled Commercial Bank recognized by RBI... (Rs. 100 Lakh for Engg, Rs. 50 Lakh others)
Required_Authentication: Bank Manager signature and branch seal
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Valid as on the date of Scrutiny
Potential_Verification_Method: Bank confirmation letter / Certificate 3 verification

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Institutions other than Government cannot use the name of Technical Institution in such a way that the abbreviated form... becomes IIM/IIT/IISc/NIT... nor use Government/India/National under Emblems and Names Act 1950
Potential_Verification_Method: Automated abbreviation filter & prohibited token blacklist

Requirement_Title: Division & Intake Ceilings for New Institutions
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Table 1.3 Intake, number of Courses & Division allowed... Diploma/UG Engineering: 60/30 per division, Max 6 courses, Max 6/12 divisions, Max 360 intake
Potential_Verification_Method: Deterministic ceiling check against Table 1.3

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: In case of Engineering and Technology program, the promoter should start with a minimum of four courses out of which there should be at least THREE CORE BRANCHES/COURSES... and ONE course of emerging area
Potential_Verification_Method: Cross-check proposed courses against Annexure-11 core branch list

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: In case of online EVC, the institution shall prepare a video showcasing all the infrastructural facilities for not less than 30 minutes and shall upload the same in the Trust / Society website and share the link
Potential_Verification_Method: Institutional briefing on camera
Human_Review_Required: URL liveness check and GPS coordinate cross-check

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Applicants... recommended for LoA... shall create Security Deposit for 10 years (e.g. Engg UG Rs. 35 Lakh; PG Rs. 15 Lakh; Double in case of private leased building/land)
Potential_Verification_Method: AICTE Finance Portal / RTGS reconciliation

Requirement_Title: Extended EoA for 3 Years (NIRF / NBA / NAAC)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Existing institutions shall be eligible for getting 3 years’ Extension of Approval (EoA)... by meeting ANY ONE: NIRF ranked, QS Asia, NBA >= 30% courses, NAAC >= 3.01, Autonomous, or >80% admission for 5 yrs
Required_Supporting_Document: NAAC Score Sheet / NBA Letter / NIRF Ranking Certificate
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Valid through at least April 30 of evaluation cycle
Potential_Verification_Method: NBA / NAAC public accreditation portal lookup

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: All Institutions shall upload the documents (Digitally Signed using DSC) as per Annexure-2 of the Approval Process Handbook on AICTE Web-Portal. Hard Copies NEED NOT be submitted
Potential_Verification_Method: Various Competent Authorities

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: If any document submitted is found to be fraudulent, criminal case shall be filed against the Director/Principal of the Institution and Chairman/ Secretary of the Trust/ Society/Company.
Activating_Conditions: Discovery of fabricated or tampered submissions
Potential_Verification_Method: Standing Complaint Scrutiny Committee / Legal Bureau

Requirement_Title: Core Branch Prerequisite for Intake Expansion
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Increase in intake / Additional Course in Diploma / UG / PG... in Engineering and Technology shall be permissible, if the Institution is already offering minimum three (3) courses in Core Branches
Potential_Verification_Method: Automated cross-check against existing active courses

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Five percent (5%) of seats within the 'Approved Intake' shall be allowed for admission under NRI category.
Required_Supporting_Document: Format 3 Resolution & State Admission Authority Notification
Potential_Verification_Method: Deterministic formula check: proposed_nri <= 0.05 * approved_intake

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Fifteen percent (15%) supernumerary seats over and above 'Approved Intake'... One third (1/3) shall be reserved for Children of Indian Workers in Gulf Countries. Eligible if >=80% avg enrollment last 3 yrs
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: AICTE Web Portal & State Admission Authority
Potential_Verification_Method: Enrollment sanity verification + 15% quota calculation

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Institutions which are existence for at least Ten (10) years and meeting any of: NIRF, QS, NBA >=50%, NAAC >=3.01... permitted to introduce ONE Off-Campus within Jurisdiction of affiliating University/city
Required_Supporting_Document: Initial LoA (proof of 10 years) + University NOC + Annexure-3 Plan
Potential_Verification_Method: Verification of inception date from initial LoA archive

Requirement_Title: Prohibition on Intra-Day Student Movement on Merger
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Intra-Day movement of Students and Faculty not Allowed under any circumstances (in case of infrastructure & other facilities required by Parent institution after merger are in multiple locations).
Potential_Verification_Method: Physical / Online EVC inspection of distance between sites (<=2km)

Requirement_Title: Conversion of Diploma to Degree Level Criteria
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Only the Institutions which are in existence for a minimum period of 5 years are eligible [for conversion of Diploma to Degree and vice-versa]
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: Affiliating University & State Board of Technical Education
Potential_Verification_Method: Verification of historical approval ledger in AICTE portal

Requirement_Title: Consecutive Break in EoA Cap (6 Years)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Institution not applied for EoA for SIX (06) years consecutively shall not be eligible to apply under Break in EoA and such Institutions shall apply as a New Technical Institution
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Elapsed years since last approved EoA <= 6
Potential_Verification_Method: AICTE Central Portal historical approval query

Requirement_Title: Prohibition on Partial University Course Approvals
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Application for partial approval of any Programme(s)/Course(s)/Intake at any level shall NOT be permitted. Universities... shall have to obtain approval for all the Technical Programme(s)/Course(s)
Potential_Verification_Method: Reconcile total university prospectus against AICTE application

Requirement_Title: Faculty Salary Payment via Electronic Clearing Service (ECS)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: The Institutions shall ensure the timely and complete payment of the salary of Faculty by Electronic Clearing Service through Nationalized Banks... annual salary paid statements
Required_Supporting_Document: Annual Bank Salary Paid Statements / Form 16
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Monthly transactions across full academic year
Potential_Verification_Method: Bank statement cross-check against faculty payroll roster

Requirement_Title: Prohibition on Retaining Original Faculty Certificates
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: The Institution should not demand for the Original Degree Certificates (except for verification) from the Faculty members at the time of joining the Institution.
Potential_Verification_Method: Staff grievance check / SCSC complaint registry

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Land required shall be with clear title in the name of the trust / society / company or on a long term lease for a minimum period of 30 years. The Live Lease has to be at least equal to Maximum duration of program
Required_Supporting_Document: Registered Lease Deed / Sale Deed & Certificate 1
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Duration >= 30 years; live lease >= course duration
Potential_Verification_Method: Sub-Registrar Land Registry / Advocate Title Certificate

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Plot(s) of Land under consideration shall be contiguous and shall have no obstacles such as river, canals, rail tracks, highways... Land shall be in a maximum of THREE plots... distance <= 2 km
Required_Supporting_Document: Village Map / Topo Sketch & Architect Certificate 2
Potential_Verification_Method: Satellite GIS mapping & Revenue Survey Map verification

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Occupancy Certificate/ Completion Certificate/ Building License/ Form D (as applicable) shall be obtained from the Competent Authority... For Government Buildings, Govt Building Act 1899 applies
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: Competent Authority per Annexure-14 (Municipal Corp / DTCP / Collector)
Required_Authentication: Official seal of designated Annexure-14 authority
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Prior to occupation; valid indefinitely unless altered
Potential_Verification_Method: Cross-check issuing body against Annexure-14 state list

Requirement_Title: Structural Stability Certificate for Buildings > 30 Years
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: After the expiry of a period of thirty years from the issue of Completion Certificate, a Structural Stability Certificate from registered Structural Engineer... safe for human habitation... valid for FIVE years
Required_Supporting_Document: Structural Stability Certificate & Safe Foundation Certificate
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: Registered Structural Engineer (Master's in Structural Engg)
Required_Authentication: Council of Architecture / IEI registration stamp
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Valid for exactly 5 years from issuance
Potential_Verification_Method: Verify structural engineer credentials and completion date

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: A valid Fire Safety Certificate shall be obtained from the Competent Authority.
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: State Fire Services Department / Chief Fire Officer
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Must be unexpired and renewed per state municipal law
Potential_Verification_Method: State Fire Department NOC verification portal

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: The Institutions shall not directly or indirectly, demand or charge or accept, Capitation Fee or demand any donation, by way of consideration for admission to any seat in any Course.
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: State Fee Regulatory Authority / Head of Institution
Potential_Verification_Method: Audit statement inspection & grievance cell cross-check

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: 10% of reservation for Economically Weaker Section (EWS)... intake in these institutions shall be 1.25 times of the existing intake of respective categories
Required_Supporting_Document: Sanctioned Intake Schedule & State Admission Roster
Potential_Verification_Method: Check 1.25x intake multiplier against EWS seat allocation

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: This scheme shall be applicable to all approved Technical Institutions... mandatory... up to a maximum of 5% of 'Approved Intake' per Course shall be supernumerary... parents annual income <= 8.00 Lakh
Activating_Conditions: >= 50% approved intake filled in prior academic year
Required_Supporting_Document: State Merit List for TFW Admissions
Potential_Verification_Method: Check TFW seats <= 0.05 * approved intake per branch

Requirement_Title: Student Fee Refund Window (Max Rs 1000 Deduction)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: withdrawing before start of Course, entire Fee... after deduction of processing Fee of not more than Rs. 1000/- shall be refunded... within 7 days
Potential_Verification_Method: Reviewer inspection of refund complaints in PGRC portal

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Every Institution... shall constitute an Anti-Ragging Committee... and Anti-Ragging Squad; Installing CCTV cameras at vital points; online compliance at www.antiragging.in
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: Head of Institution / National Anti-Ragging Cell
Potential_Verification_Method: Check committee constitution order & CCTV installation proof

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Every Technical Institution shall constitute an Internal Committee (IC)... Presiding Officer shall be a woman Faculty member at senior Level... Annual Report uploaded by 30th June
Required_Supporting_Document: Internal Committee Constitution Order & Annual Report
Potential_Verification_Method: Verify Presiding Officer rank and annual report filing

Requirement_Title: Committee for SC/ST (5 Members with Woman Member)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Committee for SC/ ST (As per SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act 1989)... Committee shall consist of five members, out of which at least 2 members shall be SC/ST and one member shall be a woman.
Potential_Verification_Method: Inspect committee member roster for quota composition

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Every AICTE approved institution shall constitute Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC)... Appointment of OMBUDSMAN by the University... report within 15 days
Required_Supporting_Document: SGRC Office Order & University Ombudsman Notification
Potential_Verification_Method: Verify SGRC composition and Ombudsman appointment letter

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: establishment of IIC in HEI is an essential item, for which all participating institutes are required to upload the copy of the IIC establishment certificate and IIC registration number
Required_Supporting_Document: IIC Establishment Certificate & IIC Registration Number
Potential_Verification_Method: MIC Portal (iic.mic.gov.in) verification

Requirement_Title: Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) / APAAR Compliance
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Compliance of the Academic Bank of Credit (ABC) as per MoE directives (Applicable for Standalone Institutions, PGDM/PGCM and Universities)
Required_Supporting_Document: ABC Institutional Registration ID & Student Upload Ledger
Potential_Verification_Method: NAD / ABC portal registry query

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Establishment of 24x7 women helpline number and a security system in the campus for providing safety to students and female faculty and non-teaching faculty.
Required_Supporting_Document: Campus Security Roster & Website Publication Screenshot
Potential_Verification_Method: Verify published helpline number and physical signage

Requirement_Title: Penal Action for Unqualified Principal (>12 Months)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: An Institution, NOT having qualified Principal/ Director for a period more than 12 months shall be liable for penal action (s) by the Council till the regular Principal/ Director is appointed.
Required_Supporting_Document: Principal Appointment Order & Selection Committee Minutes
Potential_Verification_Method: Check duration between predecessor exit date and appointment

Requirement_Title: 5x Tuition Fee Fine for Excess Admissions
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Excess admission over the 'Approved Intake' shall not be allowed... Five times the total Fee collected for complete duration of the course per student shall be levied against each excess admission as fine
Required_Supporting_Document: Admitted Student Ledger vs AICTE Approved Intake Letter
Potential_Verification_Method: Compare total admitted students against approved ceiling

Requirement_Title: Certificate 2 - Registered Architect Building Plan Certification
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Building Plan of the Institution (Certificate-2) should have been prepared by an Architect registered with Council of Architecture... and approved by Competent Authority
Required_Authentication: Architect CA Registration Number and Seal
Potential_Verification_Method: Council of Architecture membership verification

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Certificate 3 issued by the Bank Manager regarding financial status of the Applicant [operational funds and FDRs]
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: Bank Branch Manager of Scheduled Bank
Required_Authentication: Official bank branch seal & manager signature
Potential_Verification_Method: Direct bank branch inquiry / verifiable bank letter

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Certificate 1 of an Advocate (To be produced in the Letterhead of Advocate)... verifying Trust registration, Land documents, Land Use, Land Conversion
Activating_Conditions: Land ownership or private lease submission
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: Advocate registered with Bar Council of India
Potential_Verification_Method: Bar Council advocate enrollment verification

Requirement_Title: Mandatory EVC Video Upload on YouTube (30 Mins)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Video Recording of about 30 minutes shall be uploaded on YouTube and URL link shall be provided in the AICTE portal for advance viewing by committee members
Required_Supporting_Document: Public / Unlisted YouTube Video URL Link
Potential_Verification_Method: Automated URL validity & duration verification (>= 30 mins)

Requirement_Title: Classroom Carpet Area Norms (66 sq m / 33 sq m)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Class Rooms: 66 sq m for division of 60; 33 sq m for division of 30. Total Rooms = Divisions/yr x Duration x 0.5; Tutorial Rooms = 25% of Classrooms (33 sq m)
Required_Supporting_Document: Certificate 2 Carpet Area Schedule & Building Plan
Potential_Verification_Method: Formula validation: room_count >= divisions * duration * 0.5

Requirement_Title: Administrative Area Minimum (750 sq m for <=300 Intake)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: An institution should possess a total administrative area of minimum 750 sq. m. for an approved intake up to 300 (Principal, Board room, Office, Cabins, Central Store)
Potential_Verification_Method: Sum carpet area of administrative spaces >= 750 sq m

Requirement_Title: Amenities Area Minimum (500 sq m for <=300 Intake)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: An institution should possess a total amenities area of minimum 500 sq. m. for an approved intake up to 300 (Toilets, Common rooms, Cafeteria, First aid, Stationery)
Potential_Verification_Method: Sum carpet area of amenities spaces >= 500 sq m

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Engineering UG: 1:10; PG: 1:4; Diploma: 1:10. Minimum 20 PCs per Department; Printers min 5% of PCs; Bandwidth min 100Mbps up to 300 intake
Required_Supporting_Document: Stock Register Invoices & ISP Bandwidth Bill
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Active bandwidth contract in current academic year
Potential_Verification_Method: Formula validation: pcs >= intake / ratio; bandwidth >= threshold

Requirement_Title: Library Book Titles & Volumes per Division
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Engineering UG: 100 titles (First Year) + 50 per course/yr; Volumes = 5 x Titles x Divisions. Reading room seating capacity = 15% of total students (Max 150)
Potential_Verification_Method: Formula validation: volumes >= 5 * titles * divisions

Requirement_Title: Mandatory Scopus / Web of Science Journal Subscription
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Under Graduate & Post Graduate: 6 x N (For each Level) Journals indexed by Scopus / Web of Science / Medline (N = total courses)
Required_Supporting_Document: Journal Subscription Invoices / e-ShodhSindhu Consortium Proof
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Active subscription in current calendar year
Potential_Verification_Method: Verify ISSN numbers and Scopus / Web of Science indexing status

Requirement_Title: Faculty Cadre Ratio (1:2:6) and FSR (1:20 UG Engineering)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Under Graduate Engineering: Faculty Student Ratio 1:20; Cadre Ratio 1:2:6 (Professor : Associate Professor : Assistant Professor). Formula: S/(20*R)
Required_Supporting_Document: Faculty Payroll Register & Form 16 / Aadhaar Seeding
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Active employment in current academic session
Potential_Verification_Method: Formula validation: total_faculty >= S/20; cadre distribution 1:2:6

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: Score in Common Admission test (CAT/XAT/CMAT/MAT/GMAT/CUET): 35 to 60%; Academic performance: 5 to 25%; Group discussion/interview: 20 to 45%; Diversity: 5 to 20%
Required_Supporting_Document: Institutional Admission Brochure & Merit Computation Matrix
Required_Authentication: Published merit list with component breakdown
Potential_Verification_Method: Verify computed student composite scores against published weights

Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: The following information shall be given in information Brochure besides being hosted on Institution's official Website (18 sections)... single PDF file under attachments
Required_Supporting_Document: Single PDF Document URL on Institutional Website
Potential_Verification_Method: Automated crawler verifying presence of all 18 mandatory sections

Requirement_Title: State Government / UT No Objection Certificate (NOC)
Requirement_Text_Faithful_Transcription: No Objection Certificate from State Government/ UT... confirming no objection for New Institution, Closure, Site Change, Women to Co-Ed, Level Conversion
Required_Issuer_or_Authority: Authorized Signatory of State Technical Education Dept
Validity_or_Date_Constraints: Issued prior to AICTE approval cutoff
Potential_Verification_Method: Verification of state government dispatch / gazette notification
